title: US military aircraft leave second UK base
description: The departures come weeks after the US withdrew bombers from RAF Fairford airbase over a suspected Iran-linked security incident.

title: Met Police investigate several new reports on Russell Brand following his conviction
description: Det Supt Andy Furphy says the force had received "several reports in during the trial and since the trial".

title: Phones to be banned from pupils' bags or pockets under stricter rules for schools in England
description: The government says it is strengthening its guidance for schools in England, which came into force in June.

title: Edinburgh Academy pupils suffered decades of 'dreadful abuse'
description: A report from the Scottish Child Abuse Inquiry says the school focused on protecting its reputation and ignored complaints.

title: Trump says more US attacks on Iran 'highly unlikely'
description: The president says the US is keeping "status quo" with Iran but remains “locked and loaded” should the situation change.

title: The superpower battle over energy – and what it means for your bills
description: A tug-of-war between China and the US could have a big impact on energy costs, but who will win?

title: Meghan joins Harry in Brussels in first public appearance since father's arrest
description: The Duchess of Sussex had pulled out of giving a speech with Prince Harry at the event promoting children's online safety.

title: Sales of tinned food and bottled water  jump after 'Be Ready' campaign launch
description: Sales of essential goods such as hand sanitiser soar after the government called on households to be prepared for emergencies.

title: Kim Kardashian's Skims offers refunds for $148 advent calendar after backlash
description: The contents of the calendar, including hair clips and keychains, have been widely criticised on social media.
